name: Poured Out Hearts
source:
You play as a half-vampiric girl who never got to learn much about what it means to be a vampire. One night after a frustrating week of work, you heard there's a bar hosting a vampire-exclusive happy hour. You thought you might as well check it out! You didn't expect such interesting new people would accompany you through the night....

[From [url=https://snorkmi-studios.itch.io/poured-out-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个半吸血鬼的女孩，她从未了解过成为吸血鬼意味着什么。经过一周令人沮丧的工作后的一天晚上，你听说有一家酒吧正在举办吸血鬼专属的欢乐时光。你以为你不妨检查一下！你没想到会有这么有趣的新人陪你度过一夜……

[来自[url=https://snorkmi-studios.itch.io/poured-out-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
